mapper.select: SELECT run_id,investigation_id,attempt,status,run_version version,started_at,finished_at FROM investigation_run WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} ORDER BY attempt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT observation_id,investigation_id,evidence_ref,summary_code,observed_at FROM investigation_observation WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} ORDER BY observation_id
SELECT hypothesis_id,investigation_id,statement_code,status,evidence_refs,updated_at FROM investigation_hypothesis WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} ORDER BY hypothesis_id

SELECT event_id,run_id,canonical_content,canonical_sha256,created_at FROM diagnosis_publication_intent WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} AND canonical_content IS NOT NULL AND canonical_sha256 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY aggregate_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
